english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something nonliving, especially an object rather than a person or animal.
Use this for something inanimate or unable to support life, rather than something that was alive and has died.

examples.english: That wooden table is inanimate and will not move by itself.
examples.traditional: 嗰張木枱冇生命，唔會自己郁。
examples.jyutping: go2 zoeng1 muk6 ci4 mou5 sang1 ming6 m4 wui5 zi6 gei2 juk1

examples.english: This plastic toy is lifeless and cannot move on its own.
examples.traditional: 呢件膠公仔冇生命，唔會自己郁。
examples.jyutping: ne1 gin6 gaau1 gung1 zai2 mou5 sang1 ming6 m4 wui5 zi6 gei2 juk1
